result.topic_en: Lecture-style notes on the definite integral as a limit of sums, double integrals and change of order of integration, and the solution of the linear second-order ODE $l y''+m y'+n y=X$ via the adjoint equation and variation of constants.
result.transcription:
$y=f(x)$
[sketch: curve over $a, x_1, x_2, x_3, \dots, b$ with rectangles]
$\int_a^b f(x)\,\partial x$
$\lim\left(f(a)(x_1-a)+f(x_1)(x_2-x_1)+\cdots+(b-x_{n-1})f(x_{n-1})\right)=\int_a^b f(x)\partial x=\lim\,\delta\,(f(a+\delta)+f(a+2\delta)+\cdots+f(a+\overline{n-1}\delta))$
$\delta=\frac{b-a}{n}$
$\int_a^b f(x)\partial x=-\int_b^a f(x)\partial x$
$x,y$
[sketch: grid with $y$-levels $g, y_\mu, y_{\mu+1}, h$ and $x$-levels $a, x_\nu, x_{\nu+1}, b$]
$\lim\sum_{\nu=0}^{\nu=n-1}\sum_{\mu=0}^{\mu=n-1}(y_{\mu+1}-y_\mu)(x_{\nu+1}-x_\nu)f(x_\nu,y_\mu)=\int_g^h\int_a^b f(x,y)\partial x\partial y$
$\sum(x_{\nu+1}-x_\nu)\sum_0^{m-1}f(x_\nu,y_\mu)(y_{\mu+1}-y_\mu)=\int_a^b\partial x\left(\int_g^h f(x,y)\partial y\right)$
$\int_g^h\int_a^b f(x,y)\partial x\partial y=\int_a^b\left(\int_g^h f(x,y)\partial y\right)\partial x=\int_g^h\left(\int_a^b f(x,y)\partial x\right)\partial y$
$\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial x^2}+m\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}+ny=X$
$\int_{x_0}^{x_1}\left(u\frac{\partial^2y}{\partial x^2}+um\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}+uny\right)[-\partial x-]=\int_{x_0}^{x_1}uX\partial x=[-\int u\,\dots-]$
$=\int y\left(un-\frac{\partial um}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}\right)\partial x$
$\int um\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}\partial x=yum-\int y\frac{\partial um}{\partial x}\partial x$ $\quad yum+u\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$\int u\frac{\partial^2y}{\partial x^2}\partial x=u\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}-\int\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\partial x$
$=u\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\int y\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}\partial x$
$yum$
$\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}-\frac{\partial um}{\partial x}+un=0$
$y_1u_1m_1+u_1\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial x_1}[-\dots-]-y_1\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}=\left(yum+u\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right)_0$
$+\int_{x_0}^{x_1}uX\partial x$
$y_0\quad\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}\right)_0$
$x=x_1\quad u.l=0$
$um-\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=0$
$u=c'u'+c''u''$
$c'u'_1+c''u''_1=0$
$[-\dots-]=u''_1\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x}-u'_1\frac{\partial u''}{\partial x}$
$u=u''_1u'-u'_1u''$
$\int_{x_0}^{x_1}(u''_1u'-u'_1u'')X\partial x$
$l\frac{\partial^2y}{\partial x^2}+m\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}+ny=X$
$y=y'\quad y=y''$
$c_1y_1+c_2y_2$
$l\frac{\partial^2v}{\partial x^2}+m\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+nv=0$
$v=c'v'+c''v''$
$\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=c'\frac{\partial v'}{\partial x}+c''\frac{\partial v''}{\partial x}+v'\frac{\partial c'}{\partial x}+v''\frac{\partial c''}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial x^2}=c'\frac{\partial^2v'}{\partial x^2}+c''\frac{\partial^2v''}{\partial x^2}+2\frac{\partial v'}{\partial x}\frac{\partial c'}{\partial x}+2\frac{\partial v''}{\partial x}\frac{\partial c''}{\partial x}+v'\frac{\partial^2c'}{\partial x^2}+v''\frac{\partial^2c''}{\partial x^2}$
$lv'\frac{\partial^2c'}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial c'}{\partial x}\left(mv'+2l\frac{\partial v'}{\partial x}\right)=X$
$\frac{1}{v^2}e^{-\int\frac{m}{l}\partial x}\quad c=wu$ [?]
$lv\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+u\left(mv+2l\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)$
$lvu\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}=X\quad w=\int\frac{X}{luv}\partial x$
$\frac{1}{u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-\frac{m}{l}-2\frac{\partial v}{v\,\partial x}$
$u=\frac{k\,e^{-\int\frac{m}{l}\partial x}}{v^2}$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}=\frac{X}{l}v\,e^{\int\frac{m}{l}\partial x}\quad\frac{\partial c}{\partial x}=u\int\frac{X}{luv}\partial x$
$w=\int\frac{X}{l}\frac{v}{l}e^{\int\frac{m}{l}\partial x}$ [?]
$c=\int u\int\frac{X}{luv}\partial x\,\partial x$

methods.what: Definite integral as limit of Riemann sums with equal subdivisions
Double integral as limit of double sums

methods.quote: $\int_g^h\int_a^b f(x,y)\partial x\partial y=\int_a^b\left(\int_g^h f(x,y)\partial y\right)\partial x=\int_g^h\left(\int_a^b f(x,y)\partial x\right)\partial y$

methods.what: Integration by parts leading to the adjoint differential equation
Boundary identity (Lagrange identity) expressing solution via adjoint solution
methods.quote: $y_1u_1m_1+u_1\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial x_1}[-\dots-]-y_1\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}=\left(yum+u\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right)_0$

methods.what: Choice of adjoint solution vanishing at endpoint, Green's-function-type integral
Reduction of order / variation of constants for inhomogeneous linear second-order ODE
Second homogeneous solution factor via Abel-type formula
